preoutcome_status: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY NEW ROLL-OUT IMPLEMENTATION OR RESULTS
research_question: On 64 fresh original PhysX task states, do certification-triggered but budget-capped privileged target reads outperform a fixed, state-independent equal quota of 16 reads across exactly the same task checkpoints, fault truths and 8-seed ordered batches?
simulator: genuine official ManiSkill native PhysX CPU; no hardware and no real network ACK loss

experiment_structure.fixed_order: ascending numeric seed, no reshuffle after outcomes

controller.actual_fault: zero arm target delta issued while gripper is unchanged and actual simulation advances; execution acknowledgement not revealed to adapter

locked_adaptive_policy.name: fault_robust_quota_two_per_eight
locked_adaptive_policy.strategy: Each 8-seed shard starts with 2 target readback tokens; at first true common bounded-action certificate refusal, issue exactly 1 privileged target read if 1 token remains; decrement token immediately. Otherwise refuse before dispatch; never take an extra read; no outcome-based budget refresh or moving tokens between shards.
locked_adaptive_policy.residual_policy: same frozen original robust two-history target pose command and same refusal logic when no query token
locked_adaptive_policy.allowed_reads: max one per trial, max 2/8 shard; guaranteed <=16/64 global

locked_placebo_policy.name: fault_precommitted_seed_schedule_query
locked_placebo_policy.strategy: Exactly one read at first post-fault decision if seed % 4 == 0, no read otherwise; precomputed exactly 2/8 per shard and exactly 16/64 overall, does not depend on task difficulty or observed success
locked_placebo_policy.quota: exactly 2 per 8-seed shard provided the fault step is reached

primary_endpoints: Full original 64 paired task successes across nine real simulator arms, zero excluded faults
Actual privileged decision readbacks per seed and remaining budget per shard; never assume capped arm spent exactly 16
Paired adaptive-quota versus seed-timing baseline discordance + exact two-sided test, no unadjusted multi-study novelty inflation
Comparison to uncapped selective reads and compulsory query, explicitly differentiating information budgets
Per-shard refusal after exhausted budget and bounded pose certificate history
source_integrity: All raw per-seed JSON files, 8 original shard stdout logs, model hashes, source commit and complete digest manifest; never fold another execution of same seeds into independent samples
falsification: If any 8-seed quota-capped arm issues >2 private decision reads, reject study
If any source seed or fault arm missing or qpos action paths silently differ, reject study
If capped arm has <16 reads, report it as AT-MOST-16, not EXACT-16-spent
If new policy failure, preserve it and do not tune state or timeout
No safety, contact forces, external maintainer adoption, second robot learned PPO task transfer or novel general minimax theorem
